observed: air-worker plan-review with executor=codex selected hard-coded claude-sonnet-5-5; Claude CLI returned [claude-code:unrecognized_model], leaving the semantic reviewer process without a usable terminal verdict.
expected: Semantic reviewer model selection must use supported configured/discovered model identities or bounded fallback and terminate NOT_PROVEN promptly on unsupported model; it must not hang a release review.
reproduction: air-worker plan-review -product <AirWorker 0.11.9 root> -executor codex -force -json; receipt legacy-default-plan-semantic-reviewer shows runner=claude model=claude-sonnet-5-5 and output contains unrecognized_model.
workaround: Use executor=claude so the opposite reviewer is Codex for this review; do not count the failed Claude review as PASS.
proposed_outcome: 0.11.9 fixes semantic reviewer model fallback/unsupported-model termination.
